proof:
have hS : S = {-14, 8} := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hfactor : (x + 3 - 11) * (x + 3 + 11) = 0 := by nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hfactor | hfactor
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  simp
